task_text: Shared tray transport and discharge: The two Pandas hold one tray between them. Each arm's small open fork cradles a tab on one end of the tray, and an orange ball lies loose in the tray. Working together, the arms must first hold the tray steadily. They then carry it through two waypoints that make a turn. When the environment pushes the ball, they must bring it back to rest near the tray centre. Next they bring the tray to an exit position beside a fixed basin, and finally they tip the ball out so that it settles in the basin. Both forks must support the tray during the transport phases, the ball must not leave the tray before the discharge, and the tray must never drop low. Phases, in order: shared_support: For 0.35 s without interruption, two things hold. The tray is supported by both forks: it has been in contact with the left fork within the last 0.04 s and with the right fork within the last 0.04 s. And the ball is inside the tray, as defined under ball_spill.; transport_turn: With the tray supported by both forks (as above), the tray's frame origin (the centre of its floor's top surface) comes within 0.025 m of waypoint A = (0.12, -0.04, 0.27). Later, again with both forks supporting it, the origin comes within 0.025 m of waypoint B = (0.02, 0.08, 0.27). The waypoints must be reached in this order.; disturbance_recovery: When this phase begins, the environment pushes the ball along world +x for 0.03 s with a fixed impulse. The phase completes when all of the following hold for 0.4 s without interruption. Both forks support the tray. The push has been fully applied (at least 95% of it). The ball's centre is within 0.045 m of the tray centre in the tray's x-y plane. The ball moves at less than 0.07 m/s relative to the tray, including the tray's rotation.; exit_alignment: With both forks supporting the tray, the tray's frame origin is within 0.04 m of (0.12, 0.18), measured horizontally (x and y only).; natural_discharge: The ball is contained in the basin and does not touch the tray, for 0.7 s without interruption. Contained in the basin means all of the following, in the basin's frame (origin at the centre of its floor's top surface, axes = world axes). |x| and |y| of the ball centre are below 0.0919 m (0.10 - 0.45 x radius; the same bound is used on both axes). Its height above the basin floor is between 0.014 m and 0.0778 m. It has been in contact with the basin within the last 25 ms. Its speed is below 0.09 m/s. Neither fork has to support the tray in this phase, but the tray must still stay above z = 0.17 m. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Tray waypoints A = (0.12, -0.04, 0.27) and B = (0.02, 0.08, 0.27) apply to the tray's frame origin. The exit point (0.12, 0.18) applies in the horizontal plane and is not announced. The tray's frame origin must always stay at or above z = 0.17 m.
